topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Shadows stretch thin as my paws scramble over old wood, the air thick with forgotten scents. Whispers of who came before are trapped here, between the beams and dust. I skirt the edge of the light, where shadows clump thick and safe. Objects strange and unmoving litter the space, some carrying echoes of past lives, others cold and void of any warmth. The walls hold too many eyes, too many corners to check. I cannot rest, not here, not now. The exit, a narrow cut in the darkness, calls with the promise of open sky and the freedom of the trees. I will find it, I must. The night is long and the forest vast; it will not hold me if I can help it.
